wu: KET Reading Relay: Students race to match 5 KET part descriptions (e.g., 'Part 4: Read and choose the right picture') with 5 sample tasks on the board. They shout 'Match!' when done.
wuAlt: KET Pictionary: Teacher draws KET reading parts (e.g., a multiple-choice bubble), students guess the part number.
KET Quiz: 3 quick questions about KET format (e.g., 'How many parts in KET reading?') with hand signals.
pres: Teacher projects a full KET reading paper, labeling parts 4-5 with colored markers. Models skimming a text for gist (30 sec) and scanning for details (1 min). Checks understanding with 'Show me Part 4!' gestures.
presAlt: KET Parts Poster: Students draw posters for each part with examples in groups.
KET Video Clip: Play a 2-min Cambridge video explaining parts 4-5, then discuss.
prac: Students work in pairs to complete 3 KET Part 4 (matching) and 2 Part 5 (multiple-choice) tasks from the KET folder under 10 minutes. Teacher circulates, whispering hints like 'Scan for names/dates'.
pracAlt: KET Task Race: Two teams race to finish one Part 4 and one Part 5 task first.
KET Error Correction: Students find mistakes in 3 sample Part 4 answers.
ls: Teacher plays a 1-min audio of a student explaining their KET reading strategy. Students listen and note 2 tips they hear, then compare in pairs.
re: KET Freeze Tag: Teacher calls out a KET part (e.g., 'Part 4!'), students freeze and say one strategy (e.g., 'Look for pictures!').
prod: Group Presentation: Students prepare 3-minute talks with visuals (posters/drawings) about KET reading parts 4-5. Each group presents to the class, who vote for 'Most Clear Explanation'.
rw: Students write 3 tips for KET reading parts 4-5 in their notebooks, then swap with a partner to add one more tip each.
st: Teacher tells a short story about a student who aced KET reading, emphasizing strategy use. Close with 'Today we mastered KET reading parts 4-5—great job! Thank you, class.'
g: Students match KET part names to tasks in 60 seconds.
Students share one strategy and get one new one from a partner.
Teams race to complete a Part 4 task first.
Teacher asks 5 KET format questions, fastest wins.
Students find 3 mistakes in a fake Part 5 answer.
diff: Fast finishers: Design a KET Part 4 task for their classmates.
Support learners: Use highlighters to mark key words in Part 5 questions.
hw: Create a KET Part 4 matching task about Moroccan festivals (e.g., Green March).
Record a 1-minute video explaining KET Part 5 tips.
Write 5 questions about KET reading for a class quiz next week.
tip: Use Moroccan teen interests (e.g., football, music) in KET tasks to boost engagement—e.g., 'Read about a Moroccan footballer's day' for Part 4.
